title: Every Mirror Inside the Word
statement:
A block of consecutive letters is a mirror if it reads the same forwards and backwards; a single letter is a mirror. Count all mirror blocks in the given word. Blocks at different positions are counted separately, even when they spell the same letters.

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print the number of mirror blocks. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 66000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
